_comment: cúramóir hooks. Verify field names against current Claude Code documentation
before editing: hook event names and the PreToolUse response schema change
The denylist hook (E0-R5) is scoped to Bash by `matcher` so it is not
invoked for other tools, and carries a short explicit `timeout`. The default
is 600s, and a timed-out command hook fails OPEN — so an unbounded timeout
would stall every Bash call for ten minutes while protecting nothing.
Guards promoted from rules (E4-R4b) register separately with matcher
'Edit|Write'. SessionStart / Stop / PreCompact handoff hooks are Epic 8's.
